catalog.name: Temperature
catalog.description: Global temperature datasets from NASA's Global Imagery Browse Services (GIBS), including atmospheric and surface temperature measurements from various satellite missions and reanalysis products.

info.name: Attribution
info.content: Data provided by NASA's Global Imagery Browse Services (GIBS). Contact: earthdata-support@nasa.gov

info.name: License
info.content: NASA data is generally available for public use. Please check individual dataset licenses and cite appropriately.

info.name: Coverage
info.content: Global coverage with various temporal and spatial resolutions depending on the specific mission and instrument.

members.name: AIRS Temperature
members.description: Atmospheric Infrared Sounder (AIRS) temperature measurements from NASA Aqua satellite, providing high-quality atmospheric temperature profiles.

members.name: AIRS Surface Air Temperature (Day) - Monthly
members.description: AIRS daytime surface air temperature measurements with monthly temporal resolution.

info.name: Background
info.content: The Atmospheric Infrared Sounder (AIRS) on NASA's Aqua satellite measures infrared radiation to determine atmospheric temperature and humidity profiles.

info.name: Temporal Coverage
info.content: 2002 to present, updated daily

info.name: Spatial Resolution
info.content: 1° x 1° global grid

info.name: Applications
info.content: Weather forecasting, climate monitoring, atmospheric research

info.name: Attribution
info.content: NASA AIRS mission team, NASA Goddard Space Flight Center

members.name: AIRS Surface Air Temperature (Night) - Monthly
members.description: AIRS nighttime surface air temperature measurements with monthly temporal resolution.

info.name: Background
info.content: Nighttime surface air temperature measurements from AIRS, providing complementary data to daytime observations for complete diurnal cycle analysis.

info.name: Temporal Coverage
info.content: 2002 to present, updated daily

info.name: Spatial Resolution
info.content: 1° x 1° global grid

info.name: Applications
info.content: Diurnal temperature analysis, heat island studies, climate monitoring

info.name: Attribution
info.content: NASA AIRS mission team, NASA Goddard Space Flight Center

members.name: AIRS Temperature 500hPa - Monthly
members.description: AIRS atmospheric temperature at 500hPa pressure level (approximately 5.5 km altitude).

info.name: Background
info.content: Mid-tropospheric temperature measurements at the 500hPa level, critical for weather pattern analysis and atmospheric dynamics.

info.name: Pressure Level
info.content: 500hPa (~5.5 km altitude, mid-troposphere)

info.name: Applications
info.content: Weather forecasting, jet stream analysis, storm tracking

info.name: Attribution
info.content: NASA AIRS mission team, NASA Goddard Space Flight Center

members.name: AIRS Temperature 700hPa - Monthly
members.description: AIRS atmospheric temperature at 700hPa pressure level (approximately 3 km altitude).

info.name: Background
info.content: Lower tropospheric temperature measurements at the 700hPa level, important for boundary layer meteorology.

info.name: Pressure Level
info.content: 700hPa (~3 km altitude, lower troposphere)

info.name: Applications
info.content: Boundary layer studies, convection analysis, local weather patterns

info.name: Attribution
info.content: NASA AIRS mission team, NASA Goddard Space Flight Center

members.name: AIRS Temperature 850hPa - Monthly
members.description: AIRS atmospheric temperature at 850hPa pressure level (approximately 1.5 km altitude).

info.name: Background
info.content: Near-surface atmospheric temperature measurements at the 850hPa level, closely related to surface conditions.

info.name: Pressure Level
info.content: 850hPa (~1.5 km altitude, near surface)

info.name: Applications
info.content: Surface weather analysis, agricultural meteorology, air quality studies

info.name: Attribution
info.content: NASA AIRS mission team, NASA Goddard Space Flight Center

members.name: MERRA-2 Temperature
members.description: Modern-Era Retrospective analysis for Research and Applications Version 2 (MERRA-2) temperature datasets providing long-term, consistent atmospheric reanalysis.

members.name: MERRA-2 2m Air Temperature - Monthly
members.description: MERRA-2 2-meter air temperature monthly averages from reanalysis model.

info.name: Background
info.content: MERRA-2 is NASA's latest atmospheric reanalysis providing consistent, long-term datasets for climate studies. The 2m air temperature represents conditions experienced at human height.

info.name: Temporal Coverage
info.content: 1980 to present with monthly updates

info.name: Spatial Resolution
info.content: 0.5° x 0.625° global grid

info.name: Applications
info.content: Climate research, trend analysis, model validation, agricultural applications

info.name: Attribution
info.content: NASA Global Modeling and Assimilation Office (GMAO)

members.name: MERRA-2 Surface Skin Temperature - Monthly
members.description: MERRA-2 surface skin temperature representing the interface temperature between atmosphere and surface.

info.name: Background
info.content: Surface skin temperature represents the temperature of the Earth's surface interface with the atmosphere, important for energy balance studies.

info.name: Applications
info.content: Land surface modeling, energy budget analysis, urban heat island studies

info.name: Attribution
info.content: NASA Global Modeling and Assimilation Office (GMAO)

members.name: MERRA-2 Temperature 250hPa - Monthly
members.description: MERRA-2 atmospheric temperature at 250hPa pressure level (approximately 10 km altitude, jet stream level).

info.name: Background
info.content: Upper tropospheric temperature at the 250hPa level, where jet streams typically occur and commercial aircraft cruise.

info.name: Pressure Level
info.content: 250hPa (~10 km altitude, upper troposphere/jet stream level)

info.name: Applications
info.content: Jet stream analysis, aviation meteorology, upper-level weather patterns

info.name: Attribution
info.content: NASA Global Modeling and Assimilation Office (GMAO)

members.name: GLDAS Temperature
members.description: Global Land Data Assimilation System (GLDAS) near-surface air temperature products combining satellite observations with land surface models.

members.name: GLDAS Near Surface Air Temperature - Monthly
members.description: GLDAS near-surface air temperature over land surfaces with high spatial resolution.

info.name: Background
info.content: GLDAS integrates satellite observations with land surface models to provide high-quality land surface conditions including temperature.

info.name: Coverage
info.content: Land surfaces only, 1° x 1° resolution

info.name: Applications
info.content: Land surface studies, agricultural meteorology, water resource management

info.name: Attribution
info.content: NASA Goddard Space Flight Center, GLDAS team
